ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only a describing word
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only an action

2. When practising Play: Structure and Setting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Play: Structure and Setting.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Play: Structure and Setting.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Play: Structure and Setting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Play: Structure and Setting.
